verdict.rationale: Vapi documents an official CLI that manages assistants, phone numbers, and calls from the terminal. It also forwards webhooks locally with `vapi listen`, switches organizations and environments, auto-detects the tech stack, and gives IDE AI assistants accurate Vapi API knowledge, which fits AI-native workflows. A probe confirms the CLI docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of CLI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Manage assistants, phone numbers, and calls from your terminal
Your IDE's AI assistant (Cursor, Windsurf, VSCode) gains complete, accurate knowledge of Vapi's APIs and best practices.
